text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Symptoms of antihistamine overdose may include drowsiness in both adults and children. Agitation and restlessness followed by drowsiness may also occur in children. There is no known specific antidote to PATANASE. Should overdose occur, symptomatic or supportive treatment is recommended, taking into account any concomitantly ingested medications. For additional information about overdose treatment, call a poison control center (1-800-222-1222).
